About this item

  • ★Classic Black Sunglasses ▶ The Rectangle Sunglasses for men makes itself be a more trendy sunglasses. Lightweight and integrally formed body make you feel nothing but clearer vision.
  • ★UVA/UVB Blocking ▶ Womens sunglasses polarized UV protection can not only block UVA/UVB rays, but also prevent crow's feet. These mirrored sunglasses are essential for filtering out sunlight, glare and protecting your eyes against long term UV damage when doing outdoor activities.
  • ★Mens Polarized Sunglasses▶ Polarized lens can effectively reduce the glare inflected from the beach, water and so on. Colorful mirrored lens can be chosen, which include the blue tinted sunglasses, orange tinted sunglasses and so on.
  • ★Excellent Eyewear Accessories ▶KALIYADI hiking sunglasses are made of high quality PC material, retro design makes itself an excellent scratch resistant sunglasses during your casual time, business time or activity time.
  • ★ Gift Idea Package and Brand Customer Service ▶ Classic sunglasses*3, microfiber pouch*3, microfiber glasses cleaning cloth*3, gift box*1. Our sunglasses for men women are also gift packed, which will be great gifts for your family and friends! All KALIYADI customers enjoy brand customer service for our polarized sunglasses. The integrity of every box and the quality of the lenses are double checked by third-party companies. And that goes with a lifetime support!

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.
